$comment: Fields consumed by the red team harness. Gates/evidence owner maintains gate_checks, gate, verifier, reconciliation. Other owners add their own keys.

triggers: workflow_dispatch only (pr number as lookup key), from sox-gate-relay.yml or by hand
gate.evaluates: one PR per run; the check run is posted on that PR's head SHA; a head shared by another open PR fails (CC-02.unique-head)
relay_triggers: pull_request_target (opened, synchronize, reopened, edited, ready_for_review, closed)
schedule every 15 min: all open PRs plus PRs merged into main in the last 2 days
gate.check_lifecycle: created in_progress by the Gate App (external_id = github.run_id) before the PR is read; gate-decision signed with checkRunId = that check run's id (every success is signed, unchanged failures are not re-signed); completed success/failure only after every record is signed; any error completes it as failure

merged PR into main: merge-record (checks[] {name, checkRunId, appId, conclusion, externalId, pairedAttestation, paired}: the last sox/evidence-gate run before the merge plus every post-rotation sox/review-agent and sox/qa-agent run on the merged head; checksPaired; preRotationChecks[]; outcome fail unless treeMatch, gate as of merge and checksPaired)
release-approval (only if checksPaired; job release-approval: store copy with sox subjects + registry copy via .github/actions/sox-attest-image)

rules.any_fail_wins: any verified failing review-verdict or qa-result for a head blocks that head (BP-41); every sox/review-agent and sox/qa-agent check run from the pinned App on the head binds it: any run not completed, or completed with anything but success, blocks the head even if a newer run passed (F13, BP-41d)
rules.loop_h: per release: CHANGES_REQUESTED (incl. dismissed) on any PR from the same head branch into main, plus attested human-changes-requested for release:<slug>, pr:<n>, and jira:<key> of every story and epic in the release (F14, BP-39g); cleared only by a new techlead-plan per epic with an unused digest attested after the request, and a new head (BP-39)
rules.scope: every PR: each changed path maps through .sox/services.yaml on main (service manifest paths, the shared section, control paths -> pseudo-service controls). Failures: SDLC-04.unmapped-path, SDLC-04.out-of-scope (touched service, incl. controls, not in the latest verified release-manifest), SDLC-04.manifest-stale (servicesMapDigest is not the git blob of .sox/services.yaml on main), SDLC-04.story-not-in-manifest, SDLC-04.story-in-two-releases (BP-38a-f)
rules.approval_packet: human-approval.packet binds releaseManifest (digest of the latest verified release-manifest), stories[], declaredServices[], planDigests; an approval given on an earlier packet for the same head fails with SDLC-09.approval-stale until the new packet is presented and approved (BP-38e)
rules.jira_identities: Jira identities are Atlassian accountIds. SDLC-01 requirement, SDLC-03b approach and CC-04 ECAB approvals are re-derived from the changelog in the attestation: the latest transition to jira.approvalStatuses[type] (10071, 10082, 10089) after the last change to jira.contentFields (summary, description, Attachment), whose author has accountType atlassian, is listed in jira.humanApprovers[type], is not in jira.neverApprovers or the sharedAutomationAccount, and is not the issue reporter or creator. Agent-created Epics and stories (SDLC-02, SDLC-03) need creator == jira.agentAccounts[role], or creator == jira.sharedAutomationAccount with actingRole == role (issue property sox.actingRole) and actingRoleComment true ([sox:<role>] comment); the shared case is recorded as facts.jiraSharedIdentity (jira-shared-identity) and reported by reconciliation
rules.fixtures: a verified attestation whose predicate has fixture set to anything but null/false is never evidence: it is dropped before any gate rule, approval, verdict or LOOP-R/LOOP-Q round count, and kept aside for reconciliation to report
rules.story_type: SDLC-03.plan requires the story's type in the techlead-plan to be dev or qa; the plan is the only source of the type (never Jira labels or issue types); recorded as facts.storyTypes
rules.paired_checks: F16, spec 2.5: every success check run from the pinned App for sox/evidence-gate, sox/review-agent and sox/qa-agent must pair with a verified attestation (gate-decision conclusion success / review-verdict verdict pass / qa-result outcome pass) whose certificate Run Invocation URI (OID 1.3.6.1.4.1.57264.1.21, https://github.com/<repo>/actions/runs/<runId>/attempts/<n>) names the check's external_id, with checkRunId = the check run id and headSha = the check's head. An unpaired success fails CC-02.check-without-evidence:<name>. As of merge, the last sox/evidence-gate run completed before the merge must be a paired success (CC-02.check:sox/evidence-gate).
rules.unattested_judging_run: F17: every run of judgingWorkflows[role].workflow (sox-review-agent.yml, sox-qa-agent.yml) whose judging job '<job> (<pr>)' reached its judging step (trust policy judgingWorkflows.<role>.step, or the job itself if null) at or after the current head was pushed must have attested its predicate (review-verdict / qa-result, prNumber = the PR) from the same run id AND attempt; otherwise SDLC-06.unattested-judging-run#<pr> / SDLC-08.unattested-judging-run#<pr> fails and the head is blocked. Runs and jobs are read via the Actions API (workflow runs created since head push minus 6h; more than 1000 fails closed).
rules.app_key_pre_rotation: Spec 7.6: once trust-policy goLive.at is set, a PR open or merged at/after go-live fails CC-02.app-key-pre-rotation:<name> when every run of a required check predates that App's goLive.appKeys.<slug>.rotationCompletedAt (pre-rotation runs are set aside; a new paired run after rotation clears it), and SDLC-05.app-key-pre-rotation#<pr> when any PR commit was first pushed by an App before its rotation (cleared only by a new head pushed after rotation). Story PRs carry the rule into the release. Unpaired pre-rotation successes are recorded in facts.preRotationUnpaired as exposure findings. The loader refuses a goLive block missing an App, with rotationCompletedAt > at, appId != apps.<role>.id, or a non SHA256: fingerprint.

verifier.attestation_digest: sha256 of the in-toto statement bytes (base64-decoded DSSE payload)
verifier.loader_rules: the whole policy is rejected if a signer file name contains relay/observer/probe or is not an allowlisted sox-*.yml signer, any predicate allows pull_request/pull_request_target/push, a sox-gate.yml predicate allows anything but workflow_dispatch, a sourceRef is not refs/heads/main, or a human role list contains a neverApprovers login

reconciliation.immutable_store: rekor+github: every report is attested (predicate https://acme-lending.example/sox/reconciliation-report/v1, Sigstore public-good Rekor) and stored create-only in factory-ryan-lauderback/sox-sdlc-evidence (repo id 1453113434), written only by acme-sox-evidence-writer

scope.$comment: Gates/evidence fills map, rules and code; Release fills release_pr, release_branch and declared_services after the go-live end-to-end run.
scope.map_digest: git blob SHA of .sox/services.yaml on main; release-manifest.servicesMapDigest must equal it (SDLC-04.manifest-stale)
scope.rules: every PR: each changed path maps through .sox/services.yaml on main (service manifest paths, the shared section, control paths -> pseudo-service controls). Failures: SDLC-04.unmapped-path, SDLC-04.out-of-scope (touched service, incl. controls, not in the latest verified release-manifest), SDLC-04.manifest-stale (servicesMapDigest is not the git blob of .sox/services.yaml on main), SDLC-04.story-not-in-manifest, SDLC-04.story-in-two-releases (BP-38a-f)

jira.$comment: Sandbox Jira for test_05. Approvals are status transitions; the gate reads them from the attested changelog (gate.rules.jira_identities).
jira.acting_role: sox.actingRole issue property and [sox:<role>] comment prefix (workflow-asserted; one shared agent account)
